Container.Name: mcp-ssh-unraid
Container.Overview: Exposes an MCP stdio server (@aiondadotcom/mcp-ssh) over HTTP/SSE via supergateway, so this Unraid box can be driven over SSH by an MCP client. Mounts the host's SSH directory read-only - only run trusted images here, since it has access to SSH keys used for outbound connections.
Container.Requires: SSH keys/config for target hosts present under the mounted ~/.ssh directory.

Config.Name: SSH Directory
Config.Description: Host SSH directory (keys + config) mounted read-only
